status: v0.10 source candidate, not a release benchmark
change: Load the optional automatic chat-instruction collector only when an extension-backed chat request supplies an instruction context and core collection is enabled. A canceled request exits after module loading; collection errors retain the existing empty-result fallback.
method: Build the same desktop esbuild target before and after the source edit. Sum the workbench entry and every transitively static JavaScript output, and confirm the collector import changed from a static to a dynamic import in the emitted metafile. No GUI timing, production-minified package size, runtime memory, or Code-OSS comparison was measured.
claimLimit: This is an initial static JavaScript size reduction, not a measured startup, installed disk, or runtime memory gain. The first eligible chat request loads the collector asynchronously and should receive a focused first-use check before a release.
